paragraphs.text: Theros had one event deck . Despite the name it only included four creatures with the Heroic mechanic, and none with Inspired which debuted in the following set, Born of the Gods . Instead, it was largely built around Azorius Senate creatures from Return to Ravnica block.
The rares in this deck are Hallowed Fountain , Fabled Hero , Frontline Medic , Imposing Sovereign x2, Lavinia of the Tenth , Precinct Captain , Soldier of the Pantheon , and Detention Sphere x2.
